feat(deps)!: link the versioned project and document cache (#942)

## What

Adopt onetaskgraph 0.7.0 across the linked store family and matching
CLI, bringing producer-side project and document caching. Extend the
existing engine integration journey to compare project-read results and
requests with caching enabled and disabled, retaining its write-back and
recovery coverage.

## Why

Managers need the same fresh, quota-saving store behavior in dispatched
graph work and the read API as in standalone board reads.

## Additional info

Breaking dependency update: public plan/store types expose the
producer’s changed Project, Document, and VersionCoverage surface.
Existing gh2 task versions require another read after the move to gh3.
Engine reads remain unpinned and versions remain opaque; no engine-side
cache or token translation is added.

Co-authored-by: Nick DeRobertis <19440155+nickderobertis@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
